name: Pop
author: Biliup
description: Text: pops in from 40 % with an overshoot, quickly appearing (in); pops out the same way, reversed (out).

ease.description: Optional: reshapes the motion (not the fade): linear, in, out, inOut (cubic) or a spring (spring.snap, spring.settle or spring, spring.land, spring.bounce: fitted to the move's duration, may overshoot) (D192). Without it the move keeps its own curve.
